senses.gloss:
a. Ved. 
__1 Skilful, clever, prudent (as an epithet of Indra, Agni, Ādityas, property and wealth) ऋभुमृभुक्षणो रयिम् [[Rv. 4. 37. 5.]] 
__2 Handy (as a weapon). 
__3 Shining far. 
-भुः 
__1 A deity, divinity; a god (dwelling in heaven). 
__2 The god who is worshipped by the gods; ऋभवो नाम तत्रान्ये देवानामपि देवताः [[Mb. 3. 261. 19.]] 
__3 A class of the attendants of gods. 
__4 An artist, smith, especially a coach-builder (रथकार). 
__5 N. of three semi-divine beings called Ṛbhu, Vibhvan and Vāja, sons of Sudhanvan, a descendant of Aṅgiras, who were so called from the name of the eldest son. [Through their performance of good works they obtained divinity, exercised superhuman powers, and became entitled to worship. They are supposed to dwell in the Solar sphere, and are the artists who formed the horses of Indra, the carriage of the Aśvins, and the miraculous cow of Bṛhaspati. They made their aged parents young, and constructed four cups at a sacrifice from the one cup of Tvaṣṭṛ, who as the proper artificer of the gods, was in this respect their rival. They appear generally as accompanying Indra at the evening sacrifices. [[MW.]]].

__1 N. of Indra. 
__2 Heaven (of Indra) or paradise. 
__3 The thunderbolt of Śiva.

m. [ऋभुक्षः वज्रं स्वर्गो वा अस्यास्ति इनि] (Nom. ऋभुक्षाः, acc. pl. ऋभुक्षः) 
__1 N. of Indra. 
__2 N. of the Maruts; इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः [[Rv. 8. 7. 9.]] 
__3 A Ṛbhu in general. 
__4 Governing far; reigning over Ṛbhus.
a. Skilful, prudent; आ नो यज्ञाय तक्षत ऋभुमदूयः [[Rv. 1. 111. 2.]]
